caption: Torque Stripe. Built for Airbus Challenge 4 at Autonomous SG 2026.
say: Meet Torque Stripe. Built for Airbus Challenge four, at Autonomous S G twenty twenty-six.

caption: The brief: a traceable search engine that cites every claim, and refuses when it is not sure.

title: Ingests multi-page documents
caption: It ingests 431 FAA notices: 323 dockets, 1,302 Federal Register pages, 2,169 citable sentences.
say: It ingests four hundred thirty-one FAA notices. Three hundred twenty-three dockets, thirteen hundred and two Federal Register pages, split into two thousand citable sentences.

title: LLM guessing
caption: Every safety decision is a rule. The AI never fills gaps from memory.

title: LLM guessing
caption: Claude may only reword evidence the rules already selected.

title: Natural language queries
caption: Ask in plain words: AS350B3, main rotor servo-control torque inspection.
say: Ask in plain words. A S three-fifty B three. Main rotor servo-control torque inspection.

title: Specific references
caption: Every sentence links to its exact source: docket, date, Federal Register pages, sentence number.

title: Unformatted data
caption: Every answer is structured data: status, applicability, revision, fields and citations.

title: Configuration filtering
caption: The same proposal covers the AS350B…
say: Configuration filtering. The same proposal covers the A S three-fifty B.

title: Configuration filtering
caption: …but not the AS350B3. Not applicable, with the listed models shown.
say: But not the A S three-fifty B three. Not applicable, and it shows the listed models.

title: Conditional applicability rules
caption: Serial ranges are rules: MSN 1200 applies, MSN 1900 does not, no serial means it asks.
say: Serial ranges are evaluated as rules. On a labelled sample A D for M S N one thousand to eighteen hundred: twelve hundred applies, nineteen hundred does not, and with no serial, it asks.

title: Revision logic
caption: FAA-2026-1338 has two versions. The latest is a revised proposal that supersedes three ADs.
say: Revision logic. This docket has two versions. The latest is a revised proposal that supersedes three directives.

title: Revision logic
caption: FAA-2013-0541 was withdrawn, so it imposes nothing. A chatbot would not know.
say: And this one was withdrawn, so it imposes nothing. A general chatbot would not know that.

title: Ambiguous terms
caption: Ambiguous: "my 787". It asks which variant instead of guessing.
say: Clear communication of uncertainty. My seven-eight-seven is ambiguous, so it asks which variant, instead of guessing.

title: Uncertainty stated
caption: 787-9 is listed for certain units only. Serial criteria are not in the data, so it will not confirm.
say: For the seven-eight-seven dash nine, the notice covers certain units only. The criteria are not in the data, so it will not confirm.

title: Outside the data
caption: Torque for the A380-841 landing gear? Outside the data, so it refuses.
say: Torque values for the A three-eighty landing gear? That is outside the data, so it refuses.

title: Contradicts the source
caption: "Why was FAA-2026-11814 withdrawn?" It wasn't. The question contradicts the source, so it refuses.
say: Why was this proposal withdrawn? It was not. The question contradicts the source, so it refuses, and says why.

title: Zero hallucination
caption: Answers are verbatim quotes. If a rewording fails the verifier, the source text is shown.

title: Zero hallucination
caption: On 42 real questions: 42 correct, 0 of 16 unsafe. A search baseline answers all 16 unsafe ones.
say: On forty-two real questions: forty-two correct, and zero of sixteen unsafe answers. A plain search baseline answers all sixteen unsafe ones.

title: Sub 3-second latency
caption: Retrieval over 1,302 pages: about 0.1 ms median, under 10 ms worst case. Far below 3 seconds.
say: Retrieval over thirteen hundred pages takes about a tenth of a millisecond at median, and under ten milliseconds at worst. Far below three seconds.

caption: Every answer exports as a fingerprinted PDF report for the engineer to review and sign.
say: And every answer exports as a fingerprinted P D F report, for the engineer to review and sign.

caption: Every requirement in the brief, shown live on real FAA data.
Torque Stripe. The AI reads. The rules decide. The engineer signs.
say: Torque Stripe. The A I reads. The rules decide. The engineer signs.
